subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

The arrival of spring brings an __ebullient__ feeling as flowers bloom and the weather warms.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"ebullient"** means **cheerful and full of energy**. (उत्साही)

 
 
• **Example: **She was ebullient after winning the first prize in the competition.
 
 
 
• **"Weary"** refers to feeling or **showing tiredness, especially as a result of excessive exertion or lack of sleep.** (थका हुआ)
 
 
• **Example: **After a long day of work, he felt extremely weary.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'ebullient'** is **'weary'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Deciduous** (पर्णपाती): Trees or shrubs that shed their leaves annually.

 
 
• **Example:** The **deciduous** trees in the park lose their leaves every autumn.
 
 
 
• **Clamant** (कोलाहलपूर्ण): Demanding attention loudly.
 
 
• **Example:** The **clamant** crowd at the rally made it hard to hear the speaker.
 
 
 
• **Rude** (अशिष्ट): Offensively impolite or ill-mannered.
 
 
• **Example:** His **rude** behavior at the dinner table was embarrassing.
